application_domain: Computational genomics: canonical nucleotide kmer abundance counting
scientific_operator: Exact variable-width canonical DNA substring frequency histogram using cooperative concurrent hash insertion, complete counts, count-frequency histogram and minimum-occurrence threshold selection.
community_use: Source Gerbil genomic kmer counting component, a sequencing-data preprocessing building block. The general counting primitive is distinguished from application-level assembly/variant-call accuracy.
accuracy_requirements: Exact integer per-key counts and all below/above-threshold decisions, all512 count-frequency bins including >=512 bin0, total/unique/below-threshold counters; full source KMer representation and reverse-complement normalization.
limitations: Complete active GPU counting/extraction component, not complete original CLI. Compressed reader, minimizer/tempfile phase one, mixed CPU/GPU distributor and writer threads remain unverified.
Dormant compressEntries is commented out in active extract; compaction is unexecuted/unported, not silently counted as active work.
Named capacities have zero overflow; any nonzero failure counter rejects. Vendor overflow sorting and emergency failure-buffer evacuation unmeasured, not unsupported.
Synthetic canonical DNA-derived kmer bundles, not original downloaded genome data, assembly or variant-call quality validation.
Complete keyed outputs retain all physical table words through a proved bijection; concurrent physical slot identity is explicitly not claimed.
Source volatile polling is retained through custom LLVM. Targets add explicit warp barriers, a synchronization adaptation, not evidence of a native defect.
